text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
This feeling, like a dormant power 
awakening inside me... Could it be the 
Three Goddesses'... !?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The blessing bestowed upon the legendary 
knights... has finally come to me too, at 
last!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
You have my gratitude. This strength... 
for the duty of a knight, for the sake of 
my loyalty, I shall surely put it to good 
use!
